senses.gloss:
ITA-9.9.27 naraṣaṇḍaḥ नरषण्डः
Sterile male
A person assigned male gender at birth with scanty semen and no sexual desire or pleasure: such a person tends to be feminine in both physical and psychological aspects, and to produce defective sperm.

ITA-9.9.28 nārīṣaṇḍaḥ नारीषण्डः
Sterile female
A person assigned female gender at birth, with scanty ova and no sexual desire or pleasure: such a person tends to have masculine features and to produce weak ova.
